title: 10 Best Stachys Betonica Preparations

Teas made from dried leaves and flowers are commonly used to soothe digestion and promote relaxation. Decoctions, which involve boiling the roots, are valued for their potency in treating respiratory and inflammatory conditions. Tinctures provide a concentrated form of the herb, often used for its calming and antispasmodic properties. Mucillages, derived from the plant’s gelatinous substance, are used to ease coughs and soothe irritated tissues. Poultices, made by crushing fresh leaves, are applied topically to reduce inflammation and promote healing.
